variables.name: NO_VALUE
variables.comment: A value for various fields to indicate that the field's value is unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: OFFSET_SAMPLE_RELATIVE
variables.comment:
* A value for {@link #subsampleOffsetUs} to indicate that subsample timestamps are relative to
   * the timestamps of their parent samples.

variables.name: id
variables.comment: An identifier for the format, or null if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: label
variables.comment: The human readable label, or null if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: language
variables.comment: The language as an IETF BCP 47 conformant tag, or null if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: selectionFlags
variables.comment: Track selection flags.

variables.name: roleFlags
variables.comment: Track role flags.

variables.name: averageBitrate
variables.comment:
* The average bitrate in bits per second, or {@link #NO_VALUE} if unknown or not applicable. The * way in which this field is populated depends on the type of media to which the format * corresponds: * *
    *
  • DASH representations: Always {@link Format#NO_VALUE}. *
  • HLS variants: The {@code AVERAGE-BANDWIDTH} attribute defined on the corresponding {@code * EXT-X-STREAM-INF} tag in the multivariant playlist, or {@link Format#NO_VALUE} if not * present. *
  • SmoothStreaming track elements: The {@code Bitrate} attribute defined on the * corresponding {@code TrackElement} in the manifest, or {@link Format#NO_VALUE} if not * present. *
  • Progressive container formats: Often {@link Format#NO_VALUE}, but may be populated with * the average bitrate of the container if known. *
  • Sample formats: Often {@link Format#NO_VALUE}, but may be populated with the average * bitrate of the stream of samples with type {@link #sampleMimeType} if known. Note that if * {@link #sampleMimeType} is a compressed format (e.g., {@link MimeTypes#AUDIO_AAC}), then * this bitrate is for the stream of still compressed samples. *

variables.name: peakBitrate
variables.comment:
* The peak bitrate in bits per second, or {@link #NO_VALUE} if unknown or not applicable. The way * in which this field is populated depends on the type of media to which the format corresponds: * *
    *
  • DASH representations: The {@code @bandwidth} attribute of the corresponding {@code * Representation} element in the manifest. *
  • HLS variants: The {@code BANDWIDTH} attribute defined on the corresponding {@code * EXT-X-STREAM-INF} tag. *
  • SmoothStreaming track elements: Always {@link Format#NO_VALUE}. *
  • Progressive container formats: Often {@link Format#NO_VALUE}, but may be populated with * the peak bitrate of the container if known. *
  • Sample formats: Often {@link Format#NO_VALUE}, but may be populated with the peak bitrate * of the stream of samples with type {@link #sampleMimeType} if known. Note that if {@link * #sampleMimeType} is a compressed format (e.g., {@link MimeTypes#AUDIO_AAC}), then this * bitrate is for the stream of still compressed samples. *

variables.name: bitrate
variables.comment:
* The bitrate in bits per second. This is the peak bitrate if known, or else the average bitrate
   * if known, or else {@link Format#NO_VALUE}. Equivalent to: {@code peakBitrate != NO_VALUE ?
   * peakBitrate : averageBitrate}.

variables.name: codecs
variables.comment: Codecs of the format as described in RFC 6381, or null if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: metadata
variables.comment: Metadata, or null if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: containerMimeType
variables.comment: The mime type of the container, or null if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: sampleMimeType
variables.comment: The sample mime type, or null if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: maxInputSize
variables.comment:
* The maximum size of a buffer of data (typically one sample), or {@link #NO_VALUE} if unknown or
   * not applicable.

variables.name: initializationData
variables.comment:
* Initialization data that must be provided to the decoder. Will not be null, but may be empty if
   * initialization data is not required.

variables.name: drmInitData
variables.comment: DRM initialization data if the stream is protected, or null otherwise.

variables.name: subsampleOffsetUs
variables.comment:
* For samples that contain subsamples, this is an offset that should be added to subsample
   * timestamps. A value of {@link #OFFSET_SAMPLE_RELATIVE} indicates that subsample timestamps are
   * relative to the timestamps of their parent samples.

variables.name: width
variables.comment: The width of the video in pixels, or {@link #NO_VALUE} if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: height
variables.comment: The height of the video in pixels, or {@link #NO_VALUE} if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: frameRate
variables.comment: The frame rate in frames per second, or {@link #NO_VALUE} if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: rotationDegrees
variables.comment:
* The clockwise rotation that should be applied to the video for it to be rendered in the correct
   * orientation, or 0 if unknown or not applicable. Only 0, 90, 180 and 270 are supported.

variables.name: pixelWidthHeightRatio
variables.comment: The width to height ratio of pixels in the video, or 1.0 if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: projectionData
variables.comment: The projection data for 360/VR video, or null if not applicable.

variables.name: stereoMode
variables.comment:
* The stereo layout for 360/3D/VR video, or {@link #NO_VALUE} if not applicable. Valid stereo
   * modes are {@link C#STEREO_MODE_MONO}, {@link C#STEREO_MODE_TOP_BOTTOM}, {@link
   * C#STEREO_MODE_LEFT_RIGHT}, {@link C#STEREO_MODE_STEREO_MESH}.

variables.name: colorInfo
variables.comment: The color metadata associated with the video, or null if not applicable.

variables.name: channelCount
variables.comment: The number of audio channels, or {@link #NO_VALUE} if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: sampleRate
variables.comment: The audio sampling rate in Hz, or {@link #NO_VALUE} if unknown or not applicable.

variables.name: pcmEncoding
variables.comment: The {@link C.PcmEncoding} for PCM audio. Set to {@link #NO_VALUE} for other media types.

variables.name: encoderDelay
variables.comment:
* The number of frames to trim from the start of the decoded audio stream, or 0 if not
   * applicable.

variables.name: encoderPadding
variables.comment: * The number of frames to trim from the end of the decoded audio stream, or 0 if not applicable.

variables.name: accessibilityChannel
variables.comment: The Accessibility channel, or {@link #NO_VALUE} if not known or applicable.

variables.name: cryptoType
variables.comment:
* The type of crypto that must be used to decode samples associated with this format, or {@link
   * C#CRYPTO_TYPE_NONE} if the content is not encrypted. Cannot be {@link C#CRYPTO_TYPE_NONE} if
   * {@link #drmInitData} is non-null, but may be {@link C#CRYPTO_TYPE_UNSUPPORTED} to indicate that
   * the samples are encrypted using an unsupported crypto type.

variables.name: hashCode
variables.comment: Lazily initialized hashcode.

variables.name: CREATOR
variables.comment: Object that can restore {@code Format} from a {@link Bundle}.
